SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE
    (m.formula = 'Co3Ti' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.element)
       c.element AS a_site,
       m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
ORDER BY c.element, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.site_label = 'B-site'

LIMIT 10000;

WITH l12_stable AS (
    SELECT
        m.entry_id,
        m.chemical_system,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
),
elements AS (
    SELECT
        regexp_split_to_table(chemical_system, '-') AS element,
        formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM l12_stable
)
SELECT
    element,
    COUNT(*) AS stable_l12_count,
    AVG(formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom
FROM elements
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY stable_l12_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_bulk.value AS bulk_modulus,
  cp_form.value AS formation_enthalpy
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc_bulk ON calc_bulk.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bulk ON cp_bulk.calculation_id = calc_bulk.calculation_id
JOIN calculation calc_form ON calc_form.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_form ON cp_form.calculation_id = calc_form.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_bulk.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp_bulk.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp_bulk.value >= 150
  AND cp_form.property_name = 'formation_enthalpy'
ORDER BY cp_form.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, tp.debye_temperature_k
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN thermal_property tp ON tp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND tp.debye_temperature_k IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY tp.debye_temperature_k DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_enthalpy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON mp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND (mp.magnetic_ordering = 'FM' OR mp.magnetic_ordering ILIKE 'ferromagnetic')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ABS(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c.element IN (
      SELECT cp.element
      FROM material_entry mp
      JOIN composition cp ON cp.entry_id = mp.entry_id
      JOIN structure sp ON sp.entry_id = mp.entry_id
      WHERE mp.number_of_elements = 1
        AND cp.atomic_fraction = 1
        AND sp.volume_per_atom >= 15
  )
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element ASC
LIMIT 10000;
